title: Polynomial-Time Reduction to Circuit Zero Testing
statement: The language of paired encodings of two well-formed algebraic circuits on the same number of inputs whose associated integer polynomials are equal has a polynomial-time many-one reduction to the language of encodings of well-formed algebraic circuits whose associated integer polynomial is zero.
